mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the retinas to the focusing parts was most worthwhile: the light path showed how the parts work together, not just where they fit.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the three focusing parts one at a time was a little repetitive, even though the pictures explained their different jobs.

surprise.text: I expected the eye-moving muscles to attach before the visual pathways, but the compatibility feedback connected the pathways first.

arbitrary.text: The required order for attaching the muscles was not clear from their picture or the goal. The hint showed what to do, but not why the pathway had to come first.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter: assembling the eye made the route from light to a brain signal easier to picture, though I would hope for fewer unexplained ordering requirements.
